verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a real-time communications platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only an open-source client SDK and a serverless demo app. Both run against Amazon's managed Chime SDK service, and nothing shows the core media or messaging backend can be self-hosted. The client library and demo are developer building blocks, not a self-hostable core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
